text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and D at gains felt rewarding, but I should base sells on the investment plan rather than the pleasure of locking in profits.","I sold Stock C at a loss, which was painful; I should still reassess losing positions objectively instead of letting reluctance to admit a mistake decide for me.","I bought Stock D again after selling it for a gain, so I should check whether a new purchase fits my reasons and risk limits rather than trade inconsistently or react to price moves."]}
